description: Company list enrichment for up to 50 domains in one request: tech stack, open jobs, hiring intent, Google Ads or the full company profile per row. The scan is free and returns a quote_id priced for the rows with data; empty rows are free, at most $1.00 per call. A quote does not authorize payment. Use when an agent enriches a prospect list. One domain: get_company_profile.

inputSchema.description: Create a quote with tool and domains (1–50; at most33 for company-profile), OR redeem with quote_id and neither tool nor domains. These mutually exclusive modes are validated by the server.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.

domains.description: Hostnames only, e.g. stripe.com; not keywords or placeholders.

quote_id.description: quote_id from step 1. Send it alone to pay and receive the results.

tool.description: Data tool to run for each domain during quote creation; omit when redeeming a quote_id.

name: batch_lookup

outputSchema.description: Fields only; full schema in GET /v1/catalog.

cold.description: hot-buyers: domains below the threshold, free.

status.description: quote: pay with quote_id to get the results. nothing_billable: no charge. ok: paid results.

title: Batch Company Lookup
